shared_or_similar_visual_information: The numerical notation 8 in both images.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The numeral 8 identifies the adjacent angle region; it is an angle index, not a degree measure. Right image: The numeral 8 identifies the adjacent angle region; it is an angle index, not a degree measure.
Rationales: Both standalone 8s are angle-region indices. They distinguish which angle is being referred to, without supplying its measure.
